problem.description: 422 Unprocessable Entity error when creating article

root_cause.finding: Frontend sends user_id as null in line 146 of +page.svelte
Backend ArticleCreate schema requires user_id field (line 19 of article.py schema)
Backend actually gets user_id from session (line 178 of articles.py), but schema validation fails first
Backend expects managed_by field that frontend doesn't send

solution.option: Remove user_id requirement from ArticleCreate schema since backend gets it from session
Make managed_by optional in backend or handle missing field

problem.description: Modal window appears behind other elements (z-index issue)

root_cause.finding: Modal.svelte has z-index: 9999 for backdrop and z-index: 10000 for container
These z-index values should be sufficient, but may conflict with other elements

solution.option: Check for conflicting z-index values in other components

task.changes: Change user_id field to Optional[int] = None
